mapper.select: SELECT id, series_id, duration_seconds, vid, import_revision FROM local_video_episode WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT revision FROM local_episode_source_state WHERE episode_id = #{episodeId}

SELECT c.source_code FROM local_episode_source_binding b INNER JOIN local_episode_media_candidate c ON c.episode_id = b.episode_id AND c.id = b.candidate_id WHERE b.episode_id = #{episodeId} AND c.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.confirmed_seconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 33
